name: Gauge Display
description: The primary needle is white and the secondary needle is red. The positions of the needles represent values ranging from -1 to 1 by default. This range can be configured by selecting the display with the select tool.
shortDescription: A display with two needles that can be positioned independently.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Primary Display Value
logicNodes.description: The numerical value that sets the position of the white needle.

logicNodes.label: Secondary Display Value
logicNodes.description: The numerical value that sets the position of the red needle.
